hooks.name: related-tests-on-save
hooks.description: Run the vitest suites that import a saved TypeScript file, so regressions show up right after the agent edits code.

hooks.name: secret-scan-on-save
hooks.description: Warn when a saved file contains a HuggingFace, AWS, OpenAI or GitHub token or a private key. Keys belong in .env.local or Vercel env only.

hooks.name: private-strategy-doc-guard
hooks.description: AGENTS.md rule 5: a new BLUEPRINT/ARCHITECTURE/STRATEGY/BUSINESS/COMMERCIAL/ROADMAP document must be gitignored before it can be committed.

hooks.name: peer-review-citation-check
hooks.description: When the experiment archive changes, re-check every citation against EuropePMC and every Wikimedia media link against CREDITS.md.

action.prompt: src/data/bioExperiments.ts was just edited. For every experiment entry that changed: (1) confirm the cited paper exists by querying https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=<title or DOI>&format=json and check that journal, year and lead lab match the entry; (2) confirm every upload.wikimedia.org / commons.wikimedia.org URL is listed in CREDITS.md with its author and license, adding missing rows; (3) report any claim that the paper does not support. Do not change the narrative text without telling me.
